purpose: Check whether any currently built or existing backend path can directly support exact near-full decode up/down CPU fallback removal for the vendor DeepSeek4 16GB cold-start SOTA path.

facts: The one-stream function requires src1_f32 and rejects calls without F32 activation input.
The one-stream workspace stages F32 activation and uses Q8_1-sized activation storage for the CUDA MMVQ path.
The CPU call site computes wdata_stream and row_size_stream but passes NULL/0 for prequantized activation, so no Q8_0 activation path is active.
The accepted SOTA cache is gate-only; using this path for broad up/down requires a separate source/cache solution.
backend_findings.decision: Do not promote existing one-stream Q8_1 path as exact up/down fallback removal.

facts: The vec_dot_type for MXFP4 is GGML_TYPE_Q8_0.
backend_findings.performance_status: decode fallback costs about 19029.457 ms, which is the dominant open removable component
backend_findings.decision: Any GPU/offload replacement must either preserve this effective token-level behavior or pass deterministic top1/output verification before benchmarking.

backend_findings.backend_or_path: generic CUDA MMQ Blackwell native FP4
facts: Generic CUDA MMQ can use native MXFP4 activation quantization on Blackwell when src0 is GGML_TYPE_MXFP4.
This path quantizes activation to FP4/MMQ storage rather than the CPU fallback Q8_0 activation format.
It is not wired into the accepted one-stream expert-pack/cache path.
backend_findings.performance_status: compute may be fast, but this alone does not solve cold source/cache pressure for full up/down experts
backend_findings.decision: Possible future diagnostic only. It needs a plan update, token-level top1 verifier, and source/cache hard-bound before any strict cold benchmark.

facts: The batch path contains direct and io_uring expert-pack read support.
The accepted build has GGML_CUDA_MOE_STREAM_BATCH=OFF, so this code is not in the accepted runtime path.
io_uring only changes submission/overlap of source reads; it does not reduce the total up/down source volume or provide exact compute by itself.
backend_findings.decision: Do not attempt an io_uring-only or batch-build-only experiment without a new source-volume/cache solution and hard-bound.

facts: OpenCL, Vulkan, and SYCL are all OFF in the accepted build.
No corresponding runtime library is present in build-ds4-moe-stream/bin.
backend_findings.performance_status: a backend switch would be a separate candidate requiring full correctness, memory, TTFT, and source/cache proof
backend_findings.decision: Do not treat these backends as immediate SOTA candidates.

closed_by_this_audit: reuse existing CUDA one-stream Q8_1 path as exact MXFP4 x Q8_0 fallback removal
io_uring-only cold-start optimization for up/down experts
Blackwell native FP4 strict-cold performance run without top1 verification and cache/source hard-bound
OpenCL/Vulkan/SYCL backend switch without a new plan and full validation

remaining_open_candidate_classes.name: exact compact resident representation
remaining_open_candidate_classes.required_proof_before_source_edit: Show that enough up/down decode fallback can be represented within 16GB host/page-cache plus current VRAM constraints while preserving gate cache benefit, with theoretical token rate above 10 after overhead.

remaining_open_candidate_classes.name: verified exact or token-stable GPU MXFP4 x Q8_0 path
remaining_open_candidate_classes.required_proof_before_source_edit: Design a CUDA path whose arithmetic and activation quantization match CPU fallback or pass fixed-text top1 verification before any performance run, and solve the source/cache bound.

remaining_open_candidate_classes.name: predictive cross-op overlap
remaining_open_candidate_classes.required_proof_before_source_edit: Demonstrate that overlapped preparation can hide a large fraction of the 19029.457 ms decode fallback without increasing TTFT beyond 33617.688744 ms or exceeding the 16GB cgroup file-cache budget.

next_action.recommended_next_step: Write a hard-bound design for one remaining open candidate class, preferably predictive cross-op overlap or exact compact residency. Reject it on paper if it cannot remove at least 17386.570 ms decode time with less than 1642.887 ms new overhead.
